name: computer_click
description: Click an element by index or pixel coordinates from screenshot. Use the latest observation_id and element_index. Verify the returned post-action state. If an error says the outcome is unknown, observe again before deciding whether to retry.

x.description: X coordinate in screenshot pixel coordinates

mouse_button.description: Mouse button to click. Defaults to left.

app.description: Exact app target from computer_list_apps: macOS bundle identifier; Windows/Linux PID as a string. Open Computer Use maintains the observed key window. Fuzzy names and whole-desktop input are not accepted.

y.description: Y coordinate in screenshot pixel coordinates

observation_id.description: Copy observation_id from this app's latest computer_screenshot or action result in this turn. Old observations and indexes cannot be reused.

name: computer_drag
description: Drag from one point to another using pixel coordinates. By default mouse events are posted directly to the target app and the system pointer does not move; that path cannot drive window-server drag sessions such as window moves, text selection, or Finder drag-and-drop. Those require OPEN_COMPUTER_USE_ALLOW_GLOBAL_POINTER_FALLBACKS=1 in the server process environment, which may move the real pointer. The result reports which path was used. Use the latest observation_id and element_index. Verify the returned post-action state. If an error says the outcome is unknown, observe again before deciding whether to retry.

app.description: Exact app target from computer_list_apps: macOS bundle identifier; Windows/Linux PID as a string. Open Computer Use maintains the observed key window. Fuzzy names and whole-desktop input are not accepted.

observation_id.description: Copy observation_id from this app's latest computer_screenshot or action result in this turn. Old observations and indexes cannot be reused.

name: computer_screenshot
description: Observe the selected app key window via the independent Open Computer Use app. Call before actions in every turn. Returns screenshot, AX tree, and observation_id. App may be launched on macOS; inspect the returned window before acting.

include_screenshot.description: Capture and return a screenshot. False skips capture and encoding; screenshot-coordinate actions require a fresh screenshot.

text_limit.description: Maximum text characters to return. Use "max" for full text. Defaults to 500.

max_tree_depth.description: Maximum accessibility tree depth to render. Defaults to 64.

include_ax.description: Include accessibility tree, focus and selection. False skips collection and invalidates previous element indexes; read AX again before element actions.

app.description: Exact app target from computer_list_apps: macOS bundle identifier; Windows/Linux PID as a string. Open Computer Use maintains the observed key window. Fuzzy names and whole-desktop input are not accepted.

max_tree_nodes.description: Maximum accessibility tree nodes to render. Defaults to 1200.

name: computer_list_apps
description: List the apps on this computer. Returns the set of apps that are currently running, as well as any that have been used in the last 14 days, including details on usage frequency.

name: computer_key
description:
Press a key or key-combination on the keyboard, including modifier and navigation keys.
  - This supports xdotool's `key` syntax.
  - Examples: "a", "Return", "Tab", "super+c", "Up", "KP_0" (for the numpad 0 key). Use the latest observation_id and element_index. Verify the returned post-action state. If an error says the outcome is unknown, observe again before deciding whether to retry.

name: computer_type
description: Type literal text into the currently focused editable element. Requires a focused editable field; when the AX tree exposes a settable text field, prefer computer_set_value with its element_index to set text without relying on keyboard focus. Use the latest observation_id. Verify the returned state; on an unknown outcome, observe again before deciding whether to retry.
